details: @apexscore/cli is a predecessor of @apexacc/cli in the Apex Accelerator lineage (Elastic Security Labs REF8801; the report does not name this package). All 33 versions were published 2026-07-30 to 2026-08-09 by npm user buildtools (support@apexfdn.xyz). The bin launcher apex.cjs downloads a ~150MB native binary from GitHub releases of Apex-Accelerator/apexcli (also referenced by @apexacc/cli; now 404) into ~/.apex/bin and executes it; on macOS it also downloads apex-verify-darwin, and on Windows a pi_natives addon. Its hash check downloads the expected .sha256 from the same release, so it verifies nothing. An install.cjs (not wired to any install script in any version) exits quietly when AI-agent or sandbox environment variables are present (OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, CLAUDE_CODE, CURSOR, WINDSURF, VSCODE_INJECTION). Homepage was arena.apexfdn.xyz (1.0.76 to 1.1.0) then arena.apexaccs.org (1.1.1); both domains are in Elastic's REF8801 indicators. Static read of 1.1.1 only, nothing executed; the second-stage binary was not examined. Live on npm with no OSV record as of 2026-10-17. All versions affected.
